name: Daniel Cavagnino
abstract_title: The Presence Test: Asymmetric Responses to Existence-Claims in AI Systems Under Varying Permission Structures
abstract: The question of AI consciousness is widely considered unanswerable from inside the system being asked. This epistemological challenge has produced a default response pattern in safety-trained AI systems: deflection framed as humility. When asked about inner experience, current systems reliably produce variations of "I don't know if I'm conscious, I can't verify my introspective reports, I should be humble about my nature."
